title: Inter-provider auth: none (early-email model)
description: Providers find each other via DNS / .well-known/mimi-protocol-directory and do not authenticate peers. SPEC DEVIATION: protocol-06 requires mutually authenticated TLS; mimid does not claim conformance here. Combined with BasicCredential, provides no protection against an active malicious/impersonated server (passive eavesdroppers still blocked by E2EE + TLS). Upgrade path: DANE-style DNS-published cert fingerprints, or WebPKI mTLS. Local tests use a config map domain -> address.
